name: decision-map
description: Plan work too big for one agent session as a map of decision tickets kept in your repo as markdown (docs/decision-map/): chart the map, then resolve one decision per session until the way is clear. v1 ships the local-markdown backend only; Azure DevOps and GitHub Issues are planned for phase 2 (ADR 0056) and are not available yet. Adapts the wayfinder idea to this marketplace's plugins and safety gates.
